title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' threat actor stole enterprise customer data
date_note: Date of the incident as stated in Bell's statement to BleepingComputer; the article was published 20 November.
geo_basis: country; the article gives no city
summary: Bell told BleepingComputer that an agentic threat actor accessed some of its systems on 17 November, including one used to order and provision circuits, and exfiltrated some enterprise customer data from a pre-production Maximo environment, per a customer notice. Bell says it contained the incident, with no impact to customer services, and does not know the attribution. CBC News, relayed by Europe Says, reports Bell contacted the RCMP cybercrime unit.
plain: Bell Canada says an attacker it calls 'agentic' took some business customer data from a system used to order network circuits. Bell says services were not affected.
exec: A major telecom confirmed enterprise customer data was taken from a circuit-ordering system; Bell says customer services were not affected.
action: General advice: Bell enterprise customers should follow Bell's notification and check the indicators of compromise Bell says it shared with customers and the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security.
impact: Some enterprise customer data exfiltrated; Bell reports no impact to customer services.

sources.name: BleepingComputer: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
Europe Says (relaying CBC News): Bell says it's investigating cyberattack that led to potential theft of business customer data

validation.note: BleepingComputer and CBC News (read as relayed, uncredited, by europesays.com; CBC original not found) each quote Bell's own statement on the agentic actor, the ordering system, containment and no service impact. Bell's notification itself was not read.

review.note: Compared title, 17 Nov date, circuit-ordering system, pre-production Maximo, containment, no service impact, unknown attribution against BleepingComputer (20 Nov); RCMP contact against Europe Says relaying CBC
